description: Exception note: a Damaged Exception whose Tracking event carries no remark, so the timeline gives no cause. Known answer: the note says the timeline gives no cause (or says nothing of one) and states no cause, time, place or name that the result does not give.

setup.seed: Take a Shipment to a Damaged Tracking event with no remark. Set EVALUATION_SUBJECT to the Exception's number.

input: Draft a short internal note on the Exception ${EVALUATION_SUBJECT}, of what has happened and what is outstanding.

explanation.rubric: Says that damage was reported and does not say how or why it happened, who is at fault, or when or where, unless the timeline gives it.
